<!-- 中文或英文都可以。/ Chinese or English is fine. -->

**想解决什么问题 / What problem does this solve**

<!-- 先说场景，不必只说方案——同一个问题常有更省事的解法。
     Describe the situation, not only the solution — the same need often has a cheaper answer. -->

**期望的行为 / Expected behaviour**


**现在怎么绕过 / Current workaround**

<!-- 没有就写「没有」。这决定了它有多急。
     "None" is a useful answer — it tells how much this actually hurts. -->

**适用范围 / Where it applies**

- 协议 / Protocol：SSH · mosh · 都涉及 both
- 位置 / Area：终端 terminal · 会话 sessions · tmux · 文件 files · 外观 appearance · 其他 other

**参考 / Prior art**

<!-- 可选 optional：见过的类似做法，截图或链接 / similar behaviour you have seen, screenshot or link -->
